Option Explicit
Public Function BuildLifecycleFixture() As String
    Dim Book As Object, Form As Object, Entry As Object, Driver As Object, Control As Object
    Set Book = Application.Workbooks.Add
    Set Form = Book.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(3)
    Form.Name = "LifecycleProbe"
    Form.Properties.Item("Caption").Value = "CalcForms lifetime probe"
    Form.Properties.Item("Width").Value = 240
    Form.Properties.Item("Height").Value = 130
    Set Control = Form.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "InputName", True)
    Control.Left = 12: Control.Top = 12: Control.Width = 120: Control.Height = 20
    Control.Text = "Ada"
    Set Control = Form.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "HideButton", True)
    Control.Left = 12: Control.Top = 45: Control.Width = 80: Control.Height = 24
    Control.Caption = "Hide"
    Form.CodeModule.AddFromString "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf & "Private mGeneration As Long" & vbCrLf & "Private mVeto As Boolean" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()" & vbCrLf & "    mGeneration = NextGeneration()" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""Initialize:"" & CStr(mGeneration)" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub UserForm_Activate()" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""Activate:"" & CStr(mGeneration)" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub UserForm_Deactivate()" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""Deactivate:"" & CStr(mGeneration)" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""QueryClose:"" & CStr(mGeneration) & "":"" & CStr(CloseMode)" & vbCrLf & "    If mVeto Then" & vbCrLf & "        Cancel = 1" & vbCrLf & "        mVeto = False" & vbCrLf & "    End If" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub UserForm_Terminate()" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""Terminate:"" & CStr(mGeneration)" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Private Sub HideButton_Click()" & vbCrLf & "    Me.Hide" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Property Get Generation() As Long" & vbCrLf & "    Generation = mGeneration" & vbCrLf & "End Property" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub VetoNextClose()" & vbCrLf & "    mVeto = True" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Function State() As String" & vbCrLf & "    State = CStr(mGeneration) & "":"" & InputName.Text" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    Set Entry = Book.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
    Entry.Name = "LifecycleEntry"
    Entry.CodeModule.AddFromString "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf & "Private mNext As Long" & vbCrLf & "Private mLog As String" & vbCrLf & "Public Function NextGeneration() As Long" & vbCrLf & "    mNext = mNext + 1" & vbCrLf & "    NextGeneration = mNext" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub AppendTrace(ByVal Text As String)" & vbCrLf & "    If Len(mLog) > 0 Then mLog = mLog & ""|""" & vbCrLf & "    mLog = mLog & Text" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Function Trace() As String" & vbCrLf & "    Trace = mLog" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub ShowLifecycle()" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.Show vbModeless" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub HideLifecycle()" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.Hide" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub UnloadLifecycle()" & vbCrLf & "    Unload LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Function DefaultState() As String" & vbCrLf & "    DefaultState = LifecycleProbe.State()" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    Form.Export "C:\Work\DnaCalc\OxForms\fixtures\workbooks\lifecycle\LifecycleProbe.frm"
    Book.SaveAs "C:\Work\DnaCalc\OxForms\fixtures\workbooks\lifecycle\lifecycle.xlsm", 52
    Set Driver = Book.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
    Driver.Name = "LifecycleOracle"
    Driver.CodeModule.AddFromString "Option Explicit" & vbCrLf & "Public Function ProbeSequence() As String" & vbCrLf & "    Dim Held As LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    Dim Other As LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    Load LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""loaded:"" & CStr(UserForms.Count) & "":"" & CStr(LifecycleProbe.Visible)" & vbCrLf & "    Set Held = LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""same:"" & CStr(Held Is LifecycleProbe)" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.InputName.Text = ""Lin""" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.Show vbModeless" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""shown:"" & LifecycleProbe.State()" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.Hide" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""hidden:"" & LifecycleProbe.State() & "":"" & CStr(LifecycleProbe.Visible)" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.Show vbModeless" & vbCrLf & "    LifecycleProbe.VetoNextClose" & vbCrLf & "    Unload LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""veto:"" & CStr(LifecycleProbe.Visible)" & vbCrLf & "    Unload LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""unloaded:"" & CStr(UserForms.Count)" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""held-generation:"" & CStr(Held.Generation)" & vbCrLf & "    Load LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""reload-same:"" & CStr(Held Is LifecycleProbe)" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""reloaded:"" & LifecycleProbe.State()" & vbCrLf & "    Set Held = Nothing" & vbCrLf & "    Unload LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    Set Other = New LifecycleProbe" & vbCrLf & "    AppendTrace ""new:"" & Other.State()" & vbCrLf & "    Other.Show vbModeless" & vbCrLf & "    Other.Hide" & vbCrLf & "    Unload Other" & vbCrLf & "    Set Other = Nothing" & vbCrLf & "    ProbeSequence = Trace()" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
    BuildLifecycleFixture = Application.Run("'lifecycle.xlsm'!ProbeSequence")
End Function

Public Function RunLifecycleOracle() As String
    RunLifecycleOracle = Application.Run("'lifecycle.xlsm'!ProbeSequence")
End Function
